# pve_ceph_crush (Data Source)

The Ceph CRUSH map of the cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_ceph_crush" "example" {
node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Read-Only

- `crush_map` (String)
- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.
